titulo: NASA’s SPHEREx Telescope Sees Menagerie of Brown Dwarfs
cuerpo: NASA’s SPHEREx (Spectro-Photometer for the History of the Universe, Epoch of Reionization, and Ices Explorer) space telescope is shedding light on brown dwarfs, celestial objects that blur the line between stars and exoplanets.
